text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, didn't actually think I'd be able to 
get it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I told them I didn't want it, and 
they still forced it on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Just so you know, I'm not attaching 
this to my bag. If you're fine with that, 
I'll take it.
